parsed.why: No national criminalisation, but transfemicide killings flagged by the human rights commission, documented male-facility custody with abuse, service refusals without national recourse, and local dress ordinances; overall caution-band rating for trans travellers.

Strong hate-crime, hate-speech and service law with high social acceptance, offset by fifteen unremedied years of birth-sex prison placement, isolation and strip-search, plus documented border document friction and majority-reported discrimination.

Tier-1 universal exposures enforced by efficient institutions: statutory single-sex-space code excluding trans people from hostels and wards, birth-sex strip-searches and custody, plus documented fatal ward denial; no working remedy, anti-discrimination protection only partly retained.

Marriage equality, self-ID and traveller-facing goods/services and healthcare equality, with arrests after a mob attack; offset by default male-facility custody, dated police impunity, religious opposition and survey-measured fear constraining openly being LGBTIQ.

Thin record extrapolated: unenforced life-imprisonment sodomy statute, documented police detention and humiliation of people presenting as women, no non-discrimination protection or recourse, police non-response to an LGBT killing, weak rule of law.
